about: fk-routes' application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk8-print-search-unescaped
mutants.rule: Print escapes the search, so Parse reads it back (case tour: a search with a space; law ParsePrintRoundTrips samples it).

mutants.name: fk8-empty-segments-kept
mutants.rule: A trailing slash and empty segments are skipped (law SearchGoesToItsAddress, whose /people? address has one; law PrintParseRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk8-bad-person-id-is-people
mutants.from:
case strconv.Malformed, strconv.OutOfRange:
				return NotFound{Path: path}
mutants.to:
case strconv.Malformed, strconv.OutOfRange:
				return People{Search: None}
mutants.rule: A person's address whose id is not a number is not found (case tour: /people/x).

mutants.name: fk8-files-rest-drops-tail
mutants.rule: A Files route keeps every remaining segment (law ParsePrintRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk8-unknown-is-home
mutants.rule: An unknown path is NotFound and keeps the path (law UnknownPathIsNotFound).

mutants.name: fk8-plus-not-a-space
mutants.rule: A + in the query is a space (case tour: searchText=bob+smith).

mutants.name: fk8-escape-keeps-slash
mutants.rule: A slash inside a segment is escaped, so the segment stays one (law ParsePrintRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk8-unescape-drops-byte
mutants.rule: Unescape reads back what Escape writes (laws SearchGoesToItsAddress and EscapeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk8-search-names-only
mutants.rule: A search finds a role too (law SearchMatchesNameOrRole).

mutants.name: fk8-search-case-sensitive
mutants.rule: A search ignores case (law SearchMatchesNameOrRole).

mutants.name: fk8-history-keeps-six
mutants.rule: The history keeps the newest five (law HistoryKeepsTheNewestDistinct; the tour makes four).

mutants.name: fk8-history-keeps-repeats
mutants.rule: A search made again moves to the front (law HistoryKeepsTheNewestDistinct).

mutants.name: fk8-empty-search-recorded
mutants.rule: An empty search is not recorded (law HistoryKeepsTheNewestDistinct).

mutants.name: fk8-find-stops-at-dir
mutants.rule: A path goes into its directories (case tour: /files/photos/vacation).

mutants.name: fk8-size-in-bytes
mutants.rule: A size from a kilobyte up shows in kilobytes (case tour: notes.txt is 1.2 KB).

mutants.name: fk8-other-route-restarts
mutants.rule: A route other than People keeps the entry, so a search under way keeps its timer (law NavigationSetsTheRoute).

mutants.name: fk8-people-keeps-field
mutants.from: Enter[App]{Next: App{Route: r, Page: Page{Input: s,
mutants.to: Enter[App]{Next: App{Route: r, Page: Page{Input: a.Page.Input,
mutants.rule: A People address sets the field to its search (law NavigationSetsTheRoute).

mutants.name: fk8-gn-goes-to-files
mutants.rule: Each shortcut goes to its own route (law ShortcutsNavigate).

mutants.name: fk8-typing-records
mutants.from: Stay[App]{Next: App{..a, Page: Page{..a.Page, Input: t.Text}}}
mutants.to: Stay[App]{Next: App{..a, Page: Page{..a.Page, Input: t.Text, History: people.Remember(a.Page.History, t.Text)}}}
mutants.rule: Typing changes only the field: no history (law TypingOnlyEdits).

mutants.name: fk8-empty-search-has-a-query
mutants.rule: Search with an empty field goes to /people, with no query (law SearchGoesToItsAddress; the tour never searches an empty field).

mutants.name: fk8-answer-ignores-query
mutants.rule: The answer is the search's (case tour).

mutants.name: fk8-search-slower
mutants.rule: A search answers after 300 ms (case tour: wait 299, then wait 1).

mutants.name: fk8-push-keeps-forward
mutants.rule: A push drops the addresses ahead (law app.Location.BackRestoresRoute for History).

mutants.name: fk8-back-past-the-start
mutants.rule: Back at the start fails AtStart (law app.Location.BackStopsAtTheStart for History).
